title: The dentist AI kept sending to the old address
summary: Local AI answers are built from what the web says about a business, so clashing or outdated name, address, hours and reviews can make AI repeat old details.

scenes.voice: A dentist moved across town. AI kept sending patients to the old address.
scenes.headline: AI sent patients to the old

scenes.voice: Someone asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini for the best dentist near me. The answer comes from what the web says about each clinic.
scenes.question: Best dentist near me?

scenes.voice: An old directory still shows the old address and hours. Another site has a different phone number. The details clash.
scenes.title: Maple Dental

scenes.voice: When details match everywhere, AI can trust them. When they clash, it may guess.
Three things feed local answers. Name, address and phone. Opening hours. And reviews, which show what patients really say.
Try this today. Compare your hours and phone across directories. Then ask an assistant about your clinic and note what is wrong.

post.caption: Local AI answers are built from what the web says about a business. If an old directory lists a former address or the wrong hours, AI can repeat it. Keep your name, address, phone, hours and reviews consistent, then check what assistants actually say. You can do that at axpecto.com.
